service_name.description: The name of the service (used for logging and service discovery)

debug.description: Enable debug logging for detailed troubleshooting

log_level.description: Global logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

log_file.description: Path to the inspector log file; leave empty to log only to stdout

bind_host.description: Network interface IP address to bind the API server to

bind_port.description: Port number for the API endpoint

ipa_ramdisk_path.description: Absolute path to the Inspector's Provisioning Agent ramdisk image

ipa_ramdisk_type.description: IPA ramdisk type: 'pxelinux' for legacy BIOS/PXE or 'ipxe' for iPXE support

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for the API endpoint (requires cert and key paths)

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (only used if TLS is enabled)

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file (only used if TLS is enabled)

max_concurrent_cleaning_steps.description: Maximum number of cleaning steps executed concurrently per node

max_clean_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for cleaning operations

max_inspect_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for inspection operations

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts

enroll_nodes.description: Automatically create new node records in Ironic upon successful inspection

ironic_auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy used for Ironic API calls ('keystone' or 'noauth')

ironic_endpoint_type.description: Endpoint type used to locate Ironic API ('publicURL', 'internalURL', or 'adminURL')

ironic_url.description: Base URL of the Ironic API service

ironic_username.description: Service username for Ironic API authentication (if keystone is used)

ironic_password.description: Service password for Ironic API authentication (if keystone is used)

ironic_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name for the Ironic service (v3 only)

dhcp_filter.description: Enable DHCP filtering using dnsmasq to restrict PXE boot to inspected nodes

dnsmasq_config_dir.description: Directory where dnsmasq looks for configuration files

dnsmasq_pid_file.description: Path to the dnsmasq PID file

dnsmasq_interface.description: Network interface used for DHCP provisioning (e.g., 'br-ctlplane')

dnsmasq_dhcp_range.description: DHCP range (IP start,IP end) for PXE-booting nodes

pxe_bootfile_name.description: PXE boot filename served to nodes (e.g., 'pxelinux.0', 'efi/ipxe.efi')

dnsmasq_dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers provided to nodes via DHCP

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent workers for Ironic API operations

log_levels_by_module.description: Per-module logging levels (key = module name, value = level)

default.name: default
default.description: Default iPXE script chain to IPA ramdisk

ipxe_rules.description: Custom iPXE script rules (one per rule block)
